answer: Each key must reserve one dedicated 500-MB/s storage lane for 14 epochs and answer eight beacon-derived random block reads per epoch within 300 ms. Validators verify controller-signed counters and compare latency/error fingerprints; keys sharing 7 of 8 rare faults merge into one payout identity. A nebula may send a signal through a trellis, but every extra fake needs another lane and 112 live reads, so 1,000 clones require 500 GB/s and 112,000 proofs. Two missed rounds erase rewards, slash a 95-credit bond, and freeze the cluster for five epochs.
